tei:div.tei:p: "$ ༄༅// khyad chos bsre 'pho'i sa bcad nā ro ta pa'i zhal gyi lung zhes bya ba bzhugs so//

༄༅// grub thob brgyud pa'i bla ma rnams la phyag 'tshal lo// 'dir rdo rje'i lus la rlung sems kyi rten 'brel gnad du bsnun pas lhan cig skyes pa'i ye shes rang dbang med par mngon du byed pa'i gdams ngag bsre 'pho gnad kyi mtshams sbyor 'di nyid 'chad par byed pa la/ yid ches shing khungs btsun par byed pa grub thob brgyud pa'i rim pa dang gdams pa dngos gnyis so// dang po lam la khrigs chags su bstan pa dang*/ lam gyi bogs 'don gegs sel du bstan pa'o// dang po la/ dngos po'i gnas lugs/ lam gyi rim pa/ 'bras bu skye ba'i rim pa'o// dang po// dngos po'i gnas lugs la/ lus dngos po'i gnas lugs dang*/ sems dngos po'i gnas lugs gnyis so// dang po la/ lus byang chub lngar grub tshul dang*/ rtsa dngos po'i gnas lugs dang*/ byang chub kyi sems dngos po'i gnas lugs dang*/ rlung dngos po'i gnas lugs dang bzhi'o/ dang po la/ dngos dang 'khor ba 'jug ldog gi gdams ngag zur bkol du bshad pa'o/ gnyis pa rtsa dngos po'i gnas lugs la gzhung dang*/ gnas pa rtsa'i gdams ngag zur bkol du bshad pa gnyis so// bzhi pa rlung dngos po'i gnas lugs la gzhung dang g.yo ba rlung gi yig chung dang*/ rlung gi de nyid gsal ba gnyis zur bkol du bshad pa'o// gnyis pa lam gyi rim pa la smin byed dbang dang grol byed gyi lam mo// dang po la/ ma smin pa smin par byed pa'i dbang dngos dang*/ dbang bzhi lam slongs kyi zhal gdams gnyis so// gnyis pa grol byed kyi lam la/ bskyed rim dang rdzogs rim gnyis so// rdzogs rim la/ gtum mo lam gyi gzhi ma/ las rgya lam gyi bogs 'don/ sgyu lus lam gyi srog shing*/ rmi lam lam gyi drod tshad/ 'od gsal lam gyi snying po/ bar do lam gyi blo chod/ 'pho ba lam gyi bsun ma/ grong 'jug lam gyi 'thud ma dang brgyad do/ dang po la/ gzhung dang sba bzhi'i gdams ngag zur bkol du bshad pa'o// dang po gzhung la/

sngon du 'gro ba man ngag gi chos/ dngos gzhi gnad kyi gdams ngag /rjes bca' ba lus kyi 'khrul 'khor dang gsum mo// dang po la/ phyi lus kyi stong ra/ nang rtsa'i stong ra/ bsrung ba'i 'khor lo/ rtsa lam sbyang ba/ rtsa gnas byin gyis bslab pa dang lnga'o// gnyis pa dngos gzhi gdams ngag la/ spyi'i gtum mo dang bye brag gi gtum mo gnyis so// dang po la gsum/ las kyi gtum mo dang*/ nyams sam 'bar ba'i btum mo dang*/ mchog gi gtum mo'o/ dang po las kyi gtum mo la lnga ste/ bca' ba lus kyi gnad/ zhi drag rlung gi gnad/ gcun pa rtsa'i gnad/ dmigs pa yul gyi gnad/ gnas skabs dus kyi gnad do// gnyis pa zhi drag rlung gi gnad la/ 'jam rlung*/ drag rlung*/ g.yo ba rlung gi man ngag gi gnad dang gsum mo/ dang po sngon 'gro 'bud pa dgu sprug /dngos gzhi sbyor ba bzhi ldan no/ gnyis pa drag rlung la/ rlung log mi 'byung ba 'bud pa'i gnad/ rlung rang gnas su gzhug pa brngub pa'i gnad/ rlung dbang du bsdu ba dgang ba'i gnad/ rlung rtsa mig tu gdab pa gzhil ba'i gnad/ rlung phyi nang bsre ba gtong ba'i gnad dang lnga'o// gsum pa g.yo ba rlung gi man ngag gi gnad la/ pho rlung drag po btsan thabs kyi bsgom tshul/ mo rlung 'jam rlung gi bsgom thabs/ ma ning rlung gis sgom thabs dang*/ zhar byung gi gegs sel ba'o/ bzhi pa dmigs pa yul gyi gnad la/ nang gi dmigs pa yul gyi gnad dang*/ phyi'i dmigs pa yul gyi gnad gnyis so// dang po la gtum mo a thung la brten pa dang dmigs pa'i rnams grangs/ dpyid kyi thig le dpal kun tu kha sbyor las bshad pa rdo rje gdan bzhi las byung ba'i man ngag gi khyad par/ rim pa lnga dang sbyar ba'i man ngag dpal bde mchog las byung ba/ 'khor lo gnyis la brten pa/ 'khor lo bzhi la brten pa/ gtum mo blo chod ma'am gtsub shing ma// gtum mo dgu bskor man ngag gi khyad par can gnad dang dgu'o/

dang po la phyi'i gtum mo/ nang gi gtum mo/ gsang ba'i gtum mo dang gsum mo// gsum pa dpyid kyi thig le dpal kun tu kha sbyor las bshad pa las/ rgyud kyi rim pa chags lam dang sbyar ba/ sngags kyi rim pa gtum mo dang sbyar ba/ ye shes kyi rim pa nyams myong dang sbyar ba gsum mo// bzhi pa rdo rje gdan bzhi las byung ba'i man ngag gi khyad par la/ dngos po'i gnas lugs/ lam gyi rim pa/ 'bras bu'i 'char tshul lo// gnyis pa lam gyi rim pa la/ lus kyi sbyor ba drug /rtsa'i sbyor ba drug /dmigs pa'i sbyor ba drug /rlung gi sbyor ba drug /dus kyi sbyor ba drug /nyams kyi sbyor ba drug go /gsum pa 'bras bu 'char tshul la/ mtha' bzhi rang grol gyi rtogs pa/ rang byung lhun grub kyi rtogs pa/ 'gyur med bde chen gyi rtogs pa dang gsum mo/ lnga pa rim pa lnga dang sbyar ba'i man ngag dpal bde mchog las byung ba la/ sgyu lus bskyed rim pa lha'i de nyid/ sems la dmigs pa'i de nyid/ ngag rdo rje bzlas pa'i de nyid/ 'od gsal rdzogs pa'i rim pa'i de nyid/ zung 'jug gi de nyid dang lnga'o/ dang po la phyi lus kyi gru gsum/ nang rtsa'i gru gsum/ gsang ba yi ge med pa'i chos 'byung gru gsum mo// brgyad pa gtum mo blo tshad ma'am gtsug shing ma la sngon du 'gro ba dang*/ thabs lam dngos gnyis so/ de la lus kyi 'khrul 'khor gyis rtsa rlung dngos su dgod pa/ sems kyi 'khrul 'khor gyis gnyug ma gtan la dbab pa'o// gnyis pa la phyi rlung rtsa la rengs pa dang*/ nang rlung sems la rengs pa gnyis so// dgu pa gtum mo dgu bskor man ngag khyad par can gyi gnad la rlung bsre ba/ rlung sbyang ba/ rlung sprug pa dang gsum mo/ gnyis pa nyams kyi gtum mo/ thun mong gi rtags dang*/ khyad par rtags gnyis so// de rtags lnga dang yon tan brgyad do// gnyis pa bye brag gi skor la/ bogs 'don gyi skor/

bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i skor/ gsang sgrub kyi skor ro/ dang po la/ drod kyi bogs 'don gtsub shing ma dang*/ bde ba'i bogs 'don 'bar 'dzag /gsal ba'i bogs 'don snang ba lam khyer/ mi rtog pa bsam gyis mi khyab pa dang gsum mo// gsum pa gsang sgrub kyi skor la/ rlung rta ru zhon pa/ rlung zas su za ba/ rlung gos su gyon pa/ rlung sman du btang ba'o// gsum pa rlung gos su bgo ba la/ lus gnad dang sems gnad do// de la mkha' 'gro ma rdo rje rtse/ padma rtse/ rin chen rtse/ ral gri rtse/ 'khor lo rtse dang lnga'o// gnyis pa las rgya lam gyi bogs 'don la/ chu 'thung gi man ngag zur na yod/ sngon 'gro rlung sbyang ba/ dngos gzhi gnad kyi gdams ngag /ra sa ya na bcud kyi len pa zur bkol du bshad pa'o// gnyis pa la rang lus thabs ldan dang*/ gzhan lus shes rab phyag rgya'i nyams len gnyis so// dang po yid rig dmigs rten du byas nas 'bar 'dzag bsgom pa dang*/ dngos rig mtshon byed du byas nas kun tu ru la brten pa gnyis so/ gnyis pa gzhan lus shes rab phyag rgya'i nyams len la/ sngon du 'gro ba yan lag gi chos/ dngos gzhi gnad kyi man ngag /rjes lam du khyer ba/ bkod pa byang chub sems kyi man ngag zur bkol du bshad pa'o/ dang po la brtag pa/ dgug pa/ mi sbyang bar bya ba/ srid bsrung ba dang bzhi'o/ gnyis pa dngos gzhi gnad kyi gdams pa la/ rtsa btsal ba/ dbab pa/ gzung ba/ bzlog pa/ lus thams cad la khyab par byed pa dang lnga'o// gsum pa rjes lam du khyer ba la/ rtsa'i gnas su bsre ba/ rlung dang bsre ba'o/ gsum pa ra sa ya na bcud len gyi gdams pa la/ lus sgrub pa dang sems sgrub pa gnyis so// dang po la/ rgas pa 'ching ba/ na ba 'ching ba// 'chi ba 'ching ba'o/ gnyis pa la/ rlung bcing pa dang*/ yid bcing ba dang*/ khu ba bcing ba'o// gsum pa sgyu lus lam gyi srog shing la/ sngon du 'gro ba yan lag gi chos/

dngos gzhi gnad kyi gdams ngag go /dang po la thun mong theg pa dang bstun nas nyon mongs so so'i gnyen po la brten pa dang*/ 'byung ba lam du 'byongs pa zad par zil gnon gyi ting nge 'dzin bsgom pa'o/ de la zad par gyi ting nge 'dzin bcu dang*/ zil gnon gyi skyed mched brgyad do/ gnyis pa dngos gzhi gnad kyi gdams ngag la/ ma dag pa'i sgyu lus sgyu mar sbyang ba/ dag pa'i sgyu lus sgyu mar sbyang ba/ gnyis bsdus kyi chos thams cad sgyu mar sbyang ba dang gsum mo/ gnyis pa la bskyed rim sgyu ma dang*/ rdzogs rim sgyu ma'o// bzhi pa rmi lam lam gyi drod tshad la/ sngon du 'gro ba yan lag gi chos// dngos gzhi gnad kyi gdams pa'o/ gnyis pa/ bzung ba/ sbyang ba/ sgyu mar bslab pa/ rmi lam gyi de kho na nyid bsgom pa dang bzhi'o// dang po la/ 'dun pa'i stobs kyis 'dzin pa dang*/ rlung gi stobs kyis 'dzin pa dang*/ dmigs pa'i stobs kyis 'dzin pa dang gsum mo// de la dang po/ spogs chog /'byams bzhi bcad pa'o/ lnga pa 'od gsal lam gyi snying po la/ gzhi'i 'od gsal/ lam gyi 'od gsal/ 'bras bu'i 'od gsal lo/ gnyis pa la/ nyin mo lam dang rang bzhin gcig tu bsre ba 'od gsal gyi chos tshan lnga// mtshan mo lam dang rang bzhin gcig tu bsre ba 'od gsal gyi chos tshan lnga/ bar do lam dang rang bzhin gcig tu bsre ba 'od gsal gyi chos tshan lnga/ gnyis pa la/ sngon du 'gro ba yan lag gi chos/ dngos gzhi gnad kyi gdams pa gnyis so// drug pa bar do lam gyi blo chod la/ sngon du 'gro ba yan lag gi chos/ dngos gzhi gnad kyi gdams ngag go /de la bar do dang po 'od gsal chos sku'i lam khyer/ bar do gnyis pa zung 'jug longs spyod rdzogs pa'i sku'i lam khyer/ bar do gsum pa skye ba 'dzin pa sprul pa'i sku'i lam khyer dang gsum mo// bdun pa 'pho ba lam gyi bsun ma la/ sngon du 'gro ba yan lag gi chos/

dngos gzhi gnad kyi gdams pa'o// dang po la/ 'chi ltas brtag pa/ 'chi ba bslu ba gnyis so// gnyis pa dngos gzhi gnad kyi gdams ngag la/ tha ma skye ba 'dzin pa'i 'pho ba/ 'bring longs skur 'pho ba/ rab chos skur 'pho ba dang gsum mo// dang po la/ btsan thabs kyi 'pho ba/ nyal thabs kyi 'pho ba/ sbyangs te 'pho ba dang gsum mo// gnyis pa nyal thabs kyi 'pho ba la/ bcos pa lus kyi gnad/ rgyu ba rlung gi gnad/ 'chi ba dus kyi gnad/ thim pa rig pa'i gnad bzhi'o/ gsum pa sbyangs te 'pho ba la/ a yig nyer gcig ma'i 'pho ba/ 'khrul 'khor drug gi 'pho ba/ rnam shes bla ma'i 'pho ba dang gsum mo/ dang po la/ lha sgom pa/ sems bskyed pa/ gsol ba gdab pa/ 'pho ba bslab pa/ 'pho ba la sbyangs pa/ 'pho ba dngos so/ gnyis pa 'khrul 'khor drug gi 'pho ba la/ nye ba 'phrang dgug pa'i yan lag /lha dang bla ma la gsol ba gdab pa bar chad mi 'byung ba'i yan lag /smon lam gdab pa log par mi 'byung ba'i yan lag /sgo bcad pas gol bar mi 'byung ba'i yan lag go rigs drug gi sa bon bsregs pas bag chag sbyong ba'i yan lag shes pa gar 'dod kyi gnas su skyol ba lus sems 'brel bar yan lag /gang du'ang ma chags pa khams gsum 'khor bar mi lhung ba'i yan lag go /gsum pa rnam shes bla ma'i 'pho ba la/ sbyang ba dang las la sbyor ba gnyis so// brgyad pa grong 'jug lam gyi 'thud ma la/ dang po sbyang ba/ bar du sad pa/ tha mar las la sbyar ba dang gsum mo// gsum pa 'bras bu skye ba'i rim pa la/ zung 'jug gi rnam gzhag /lam yon tan phun tshogs so so'i yon tan/ sa lam gyi bgrod tshul dang gsum mo// gnyis pa lam gyi bogs 'don pa dang gegs sel du bstan pa la/ rlung gi gegs sel cig car bstan pa dang*/ gegs sel nyi ma'i snying po 'am rlung gi de nyid bdun bcus dmigs bsal du bstan pa'o// gnyis pa byin rlabs dang 'brel ba snyan brgyud kyi gdams ngag ni/

lam bsdus te bshad pa'am/ gang zag cig car ba/ thod rgal ba/ rim skyes pa dang gsum tha dad pa'i khrid tshul te/ dpal ldan bla ma dam pa yun du mnyes par byas te shes par bya'o/ zla ba mig me chu gter can/ phung po/ ro ste ri bo klu/ rtsa ba phyogs dang nyi ma zhes/ bla ma dam pa'i zhal snga gsung*// nā ro paṇḍi tas bshad/ mar pa lo tsās bsgyur/ mi la yab sras kyi bsgoms pa bka' brgyud rin po che'i grub thob thams cad bgrod pa gcig pa'i lam/ khyad chos bsre 'pho'i gdams ngag lag len smar khrid du 'dod pa dag gis bdag gi lde'u mig 'di gzung na/ gzhung don gyi khang bzang chen po sgo phyed par gor ma chags pas brgyud ldan gyi gdams ngag thob pa dag/ rngog lugs phal gyi lung tsam bshad la// bka' brgyud pa phal gyi ming tsam yang ma thos na lag len lta smos kyang ci dag la phan thogs pa'i ched du padma dkar pos sbyar ba'o/// /
